topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Well, now, I never seen such a mix-up. The blacksmith's son, young Tom, he's always had a way with mechanical beasts, but this time, his iron mare was taken by the village constable right off his own land! The sun had barely risen, and there she was, the contraption, with a chain around her wheel, draggin' off towards the village square, all under the clear blue sky. Neighbors gossiped, sayin' it's some new law from the lord's council. I reckon we’ll be hearin’ stories 'round the fire tonight. But I say a man's property’s his property, no matter if it spits steam or treads soft like a pony. Might be time to march over and ask the lord what crops he's sowing next, if he's got such time for these newfangled rules.
